subject: SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT function
notes: Reads RunUnit.Current.Clock.Now().TimeOfDay — the current LOCAL wall-clock reading (SystemClock falls back to DateTimeOffset.Now; a WISEOWL_COBOL_CLOCK pin parses with DateTimeStyles.AssumeLocal) — expressed in seconds past midnight via the tick count at scale 7. The Annex D.31.5.4 anchor is pinned exactly: local 05:14:27.8124791 → 188,678,124,791 ticks = 18867.8124791 s. The clock is the ONE seam every now-function shares (kb/Work R21), so CURRENT-DATE, FORMATTED-CURRENT-DATE and SECONDS-PAST-MIDNIGHT observe one instant per run unit; ClockSeamDriftTests guards that no direct DateTime[Offset].Now read bypasses the seam.
